intent: Freeze the COMPLETE01 V3 measurement design before any V3 implementation or results: bind all four installed LangGraph distributions by exact version and RECORD/METADATA digest, enumerate all 68 non-private shipped modules from distribution RECORD ownership, assign each exact module to explicit existing frozen row/facet coverage or a narrowly reasoned operator-ratified exclusion, and state the future executable totality, reverse-coverage, and fail-closed proof obligations without modifying code, V1/V2 rubric bytes, scores, or receipts.

negative_controls.name: unrouted-installed-module-must-fail
negative_controls.command: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; import json,subprocess,sys; p=Path('docs/langgraph_parity/DHARMAGRAPH_PARITY_GAUNTLET_RUBRIC_V3.json'); d=json.loads(p.read_text()); d['module_routes'].pop('langgraph.callbacks'); p.write_text(json.dumps(d)); c=\"import json; p=json.load(open('docs/langgraph_parity/DHARMAGRAPH_PARITY_GAUNTLET_RUBRIC_V3.json')); assert set(p['module_routes'])|set(p['module_exclusions'])==set(p['target_modules'])\"; r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-c',c],check=False); sys.exit(r.returncode)"

commit.message: governance(dharmagraph): freeze COMPLETE01 V3 inventory routes

interface_mismatches: V2 COMPLETE01 asserts success literally while its scanner names only 12 of 68 non-private modules shipped by the four pinned distributions.
The V2 target omits the independently versioned langgraph-prebuilt distribution even though PB01 is graded.
An implementation-authored route map would let the measuring code define its own expected answer, violating freeze-before-results custody.
honest_blockers: This freeze contains no implementation, execution result, new score, builder receipt, or judge receipt.
Exact-module routing under exact RECORD custody is a representation claim only; it awards no behavioral parity points.
Operator merge of the one-file V3 freeze is the authority boundary before implementation may consume it.

The subsequent implementation requires a separate exact-main packet, executed negative controls, fresh builder emission, independent zero-context judge execution, and exact judge-digest source ratification.
No daemon, production, deployment, exposure, credentials, branch policy, approval, or merge action is performed.
session_entry.rollback: Remove the unconsumed V3 freeze file. If implementation has already consumed it, revert the implementation and its receipts first; never silently fall back to V2's hard-coded COMPLETE01 literal.
